column_description: Primary key (VARCHAR(20)) referencing robot_record(RecReg). Ties detailed specs to an existing robot record.
VARCHAR(60) describing the manufacturer’s name (was 'Manufacturer') (e.g., 'FANUC', 'Yaskawa', 'KUKA', 'ABB', 'Universal Robots').
VARCHAR(40) capturing the robot’s model series/designation.
CHAR(15) labeling the broad type of robot (e.g., 'Delta', 'Collaborative', 'Cartesian', 'SCARA', 'Articulated').
DECIMAL(9,2) specifying the maximum payload the robot can handle in kilograms (e.g., 5, 200, 100, 50, 20, 3, 10).
SMALLINT storing the robot’s reach in millimeters (distance from base).
DATE indicating when this robot was installed (was 'InstallationDate').
VARCHAR(25) logging the firmware version installed on the robot’s controller.
VARCHAR(40) referencing the type or brand of controller used (was 'ControllerType').
